questions.q: What is the capital of Honduras?
questions.why: It is in a mountain valley.

questions.q: What is Honduras's currency?
questions.why: It is named after an Indigenous chief.

questions.q: Which Maya city in western Honduras is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is famous for carved stelae.

questions.q: From which country did Honduras gain independence in 1821?
questions.why: It joined the Central American federation.

questions.q: Which crop led to the phrase 'banana republic' about Honduras?
questions.why: American fruit companies held great power.

questions.q: Which 1998 hurricane devastated Honduras?
questions.why: It killed thousands.

questions.q: Who became Honduras's first woman President, in 2022?
questions.why: Her husband Mel Zelaya had been President.

questions.q: Which Lenca chief fought the Spanish in the 1530s?
questions.why: The currency is named after him.

questions.q: Which 1969 conflict with El Salvador followed World Cup qualifiers?
questions.why: It lasted about 100 hours.

questions.q: Which Central American leader born in Tegucigalpa led the federation?
questions.why: He fought to keep Central America united.

questions.q: Which President was removed in a 2009 coup?
questions.why: He was flown out in his pyjamas.

questions.q: Which Honduran environmental activist was killed in 2016?
questions.why: She opposed a dam on the Gualcarque River.

questions.q: Which former President was convicted of drug trafficking in New York in 2024?
questions.why: He was sentenced to 45 years.

questions.q: Which old capital has one of the oldest working clocks in the Americas?
questions.why: The cathedral clock came from Spain.

questions.q: Which explorer landed near Trujillo on his fourth voyage in 1502?
questions.why: He named the place 'Honduras' for its deep waters.

questions.q: Which island is the most famous of the Bay Islands?
questions.why: It is close to the Mesoamerican Reef.

questions.q: Which island is known for cheap diving and whale sharks?
questions.why: Many people learn to dive there.

questions.q: Which folded flour tortilla with beans and cream is a favourite?
questions.why: It is the classic Honduran snack.

questions.q: Which coastal people of African and Indigenous descent live along the coast?
questions.why: Their culture is on UNESCO's list.

questions.q: Which rainforest reserve in the east is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is in the Mosquitia region.

questions.q: Which sea lies off Honduras's north coast?
questions.why: The south has a short Pacific shore.

questions.q: Which national bird is a large colourful parrot?
questions.why: Copán has a macaw park.

questions.q: What strange 'rain of fish' happens in Yoro each year?
questions.why: Small fish appear after storms.

questions.q: Which legendary lost city was searched for in the Mosquitia?
questions.why: Explorers found ruins there in 2015.

questions.q: Which mountain national park is Honduras's highest point?
questions.why: Cerro Las Minas is about 2,870 m.

questions.q: Which beach town is near Pico Bonito National Park?
questions.why: It hosts a big carnival in May.

questions.q: Which Honduran footballer starred for Wigan and Tottenham?
questions.why: He later played for Stoke City.

questions.q: What are the stone carvings at Copán's famous staircase called?
questions.why: It holds the longest Maya text.

questions.q: Which Honduran author wrote 'Prisión verde'?
questions.why: It is about banana workers.

questions.q: Which large lake near San Pedro Sula is Honduras's biggest?
questions.why: It is famous for birdwatching.
